subject: The 2AM playlist that unlocked a secret
preview_text: A personal thank you for sticking with us. Inside: something only long-term users get.
body_paragraphs: Two months ago, I was up at 2AM tweaking the EQ on a track that just wasn't hitting right. Not because the song was bad, but because my phone's speakers were stealing all the soul. That's when I stumbled on something I've been keeping quiet ever since.

You've been with us since day one, and frankly, that means a lot. Most people download an app and forget it exists. You didn't. You've been boosting your audio, dialing in your sound, and actually hearing what your music should sound like. So this one's for you.

Inside the app right now, there's a hidden sound profile I built that night. It's called 'The Midnight Boost' — it cranks the bass, tightens the mids, and pushes the loudness just past where it should be safe. Only users who've been with us for 60+ days can unlock it. Go to the Equalizer tab, tap 'Custom Presets,' and it'll be waiting under your saved presets.
Open Volume Booster - Sound Booster right now, and claim your exclusive preset before I pull it next week. P.S. If you share this with a friend, the preset disappears for you. This one's yours alone.
